summary: Add a protected selector-only review evidence observer

schema.detail: Portable v1 review STOP records may have no test citations; GO still requires them. Daemon claim schemas are unchanged by this slice.

rules.detail: No daemon rule or main landing change.

compatibility.detail: Adds an internal observe-review command. Older verifiers reject empty-citation STOP records; upgrade participating verifiers before activating enforcement. No gate is enforced here.

manual.detail: Operators pin the installed adapter in a protected profile with read-only daemon and GitHub access, a private bare repository and external signer policy. No production keys or grants are provisioned here.

recovery.detail: Unavailable signing preserves observed facts at degraded trust; replay cannot promote them. Missing or inapplicable observations cannot invent a verdict. Automatic invocation and publication follow separately.
